title: Solar system
brief: The sun in the middle with Mercury, Venus, Earth and Mars on circular orbits at different speeds, inner planets faster; Earth has a small moon. Label each planet.

title: DNA double helix
brief: A slowly rotating DNA double helix: two colored sugar-phosphate backbones with base-pair rungs between them in four colors. Label the backbone and a base pair.

title: Four-stroke engine
brief: A cutaway cylinder with a piston on a connecting rod and a rotating crankshaft, plus intake and exhaust valves. Animate the four strokes in a loop and show a label naming the current stroke: intake, compression, power, exhaust.

title: Quarterly sales
brief: A 3D bar chart of quarterly sales in millions of dollars: Q1 12, Q2 18, Q3 9, Q4 22. Bars on a grid floor, the value above each bar and the quarter in front of it.

title: Sine and cosine
brief: Sine and cosine waves scrolling slowly to the left over labeled x and y axes, sine in cyan and cosine in magenta, with a small legend.

title: Bouncing balls
brief: Eight colored balls bouncing inside the area with gravity, losing a little energy on each bounce off the walls and floor; show the number of bounces in a corner.

title: TCP handshake
brief: A sequence diagram of the TCP three-way handshake: Client and Server lifelines, arrows for SYN, SYN-ACK and ACK with example sequence numbers, and a note at the bottom that the connection is established.

title: Water cycle
brief: The water cycle: ocean, sun, clouds, a mountain and a river back to the ocean, with curved arrows labeled evaporation, condensation, precipitation and runoff.

title: HTTP versions
brief: A comparison table of HTTP/1.1, HTTP/2 and HTTP/3: transport, multiplexing, header compression, head-of-line blocking and the year each was introduced, with the best value in each row highlighted.

title: Apollo timeline
brief: A vertical timeline of the Apollo program's key missions: Apollo 1, 7, 8, 11, 13 and 17, each with its date and one line on what happened.
